note: Expected results of `python3 -m clausal separate`, written BEFORE the first run of any of these cases (see README.md). `verdict` is the exact verdict of the one comparison of the case. Points are grid values by variable name.

cases.what: accepted only against accepted or rejected, on the wallet fixture
sentences: A successful withdrawal decreases the wallet's balance by exactly the amount
A withdrawal decreases the wallet's balance by exactly the amount

cases.what: a strict against a non-strict bound, on the wallet fixture
sentences: A transfer is accepted only if the amount is not more than the sender's balance
A transfer is accepted only if the sender's balance is more than the amount

cases.what: the wallet-versus-ledger transfer, as two sentences: the trial's sentence and the ledger wording
sentences: A transfer never changes the total of all balances
A transfer never changes the total of all balances of the ledger

cases.what: the trial's sentence alone: it compiles in one system only, and the tool must say that the noun names operations in two
sentences: A transfer never changes the total of all balances

cases.what: one sentence that compiles in both systems (the compiler refuses it as AMBIGUOUS): both candidates, an input in each
two sentences that mean the same and compile to the same term (two surface forms of one piece)
sentences: A computation of the total is always accepted
A computation of the total always succeeds

cases.what: two sentences that mean the same with different terms: 'exactly when' against 'whenever ... and ... only if'
sentences: A transfer is accepted exactly when the transfer is valid on the ledger
A transfer is accepted whenever the transfer is valid on the ledger, and a transfer is accepted only if the transfer is valid on the ledger

cases.what: two sentences that agree on this code but are different statements (one also demands an answer outside the condition): must be NONE-FOUND with bounds, neither SAME-TERM nor PROVED-EQUAL
sentences: A transfer is accepted whenever the transfer is valid on the ledger
A transfer for which the transfer is valid on the ledger is always accepted

cases.what: a pair that differs only beyond the search bounds: they differ on a batch of five transfers that are all applied, and no batch of the grid has more than four
sentences: For a batch, the number of transfers applied is at most 4
For a batch, the number of transfers applied is at most the length of the batch
